title: That’s not Thabi, That’s a hippopotamus (SASL)
description: Lucy can’t find her sister Thabi. But everywhere she looks there’s a suspicious hippopotamus. Does the hippo know where Thabi is?

usagePolicy.reason: The complete illustrated edition and editable source files remain at Book Dash; this local entry preserves discovery and creator attribution.
